mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% over the past month signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, leading to compressed discount rates and negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in UNRATE above 4.3% triggers a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return due to heightened labor market uncertainty and reduced growth expectations.
failure_condition: Positive 5-day returns occur when UNRATE crosses above 4.3% despite the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 over the past month signal conflicting trends, amplifying equity risk premium expectations and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Negative returns persist despite both proxies rising together in the 60-day window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a drop in INDPRO below 100.0 triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as reduced supply signals peak demand exhaustion.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100.0 in the next month
failure_condition: Positive returns occur when INDPRO drops below 100 in late-cycle without a regime shift.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS alongside CPIAUCSL above 105.0 in the next month indicates aggressive tightening and inflationary pressures, generating negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns when both proxies rise above 105 in the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in GDPC1 and RSAFS over the past month indicate robust demand and business investment, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary shock regime, a sharp drop in INDPRO below 95.0 triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate lower growth.
